answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 8542 Country: India Title: meri biwi ko ek mahine ki pregnency thi lekin kisi wajah se miscarriage ho gya. sohbat ke bare me islam me kya hukm he kya hum 15din baad sohbat kar sakta hain ya jaisa ke bachcha hone ke baad 40 din tak nhi kar sakte plz inform me as soon as possible Question: meri biwi ko ek mahine ki pregnency thi lekin kisi wajah se miscarriage ho gya. sohbat ke bare me islam me kya hukm he kya hum 15din baad sohbat kar sakta hain ya jaisa ke bachcha hone ke baad 40 din tak nhi kar sakte plz inform me as soon as possible Answer ID: 8542 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1333/1127=L/1429) Yes, you can have intercourse after 15 days. It is to be noted that if the postpartum blood stops within less than 40 days, she become tahir and it is necessary for her to have bath and perform salah . If her husband wants to have intercourse with her, he can do so. It is false thing which is spread among the masses that in every case it is unlawful to sleep with wife till 40 days. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
